notes: 25 candidates: 1 program-list, 0 single-record, 24 not-a-list. The only program-list is the PERFECT EU-project page on perfect.lfo.tu-dortmund.de, which names four in-progress PhD students in purchasing/supply management from four institutions (TU Dortmund, Lappeenranta University of Technology, Mainz University of Applied Sciences, University of Twente); it is a project roster of current students, not a graduate or placement list, so it is marked program-list only because it names doctoral researchers with their dissertation topics; the integrator may prefer to treat it as a lead. The Technion graduate-school FacultyTheses.asp endpoint is a real per-department thesis list with student, advisor and graduation year, but the four captures here cover Computer Science (fac=23 PhD and MSc), Mechanical Engineering MSc (Fac=3) and Chemical Engineering PhD (fac=5); the index page (graduate.technion.ac.il/en/theses-en/) lists Industrial Engineering and Management (no. 19, iew3.technion.ac.il) and Design and Manufacturing Management (no. 14) as departments with their own PhD thesis lists on the same endpoint, which were not in this batch. The TU Darmstadt Visual Inference Lab dissertation page is a genuine PhD list but in computer vision. All twelve DTU alumni pages are news items under the DTU Alumni news section, several captured repeatedly under different utm_campaign tracking parameters. Institutions by host were kept for every page.
